LightningComponentBundle.description: Org-wide duplicate contact report. Compares every pair among the contacts scanned and shows each cluster with the evidence behind it. Runs on demand, since all-pairs comparison is quadratic.

property.name: scanLimit
property.label: Contacts to scan
property.description: All-pairs comparison is quadratic. The Apex CPU budget is exhausted at roughly 130 contacts, beyond which the run stops early and reports partial results.
